title: Explicit Process-Facing Hydraulic View
purpose: Qualify the smallest read-only process-facing hydraulic snapshot required by irrigation and later process migration without exposing HeadCalc, reference-Richards state bindings, Newton vectors, Jacobians or worker workspace.

scope.semantics: Snapshot of one physical soil-water state supplied by the caller. F-SI17 does not decide whether that state is committed, candidate or trial; downstream runtime ownership must bind the view to committed state when process decisions require committed semantics.
scope.copy_semantics: The view owns copied arrays. No pointer alias to solver/runtime state is exposed.

ownership_boundary.F_SI: Own and qualify the process-facing view type, construction and validation from solver-neutral soil_water_physical_state_t.
ownership_boundary.F_MR: Later bind the view to the exact committed physical state on an admitted runtime lineage and expose it to process orchestration.
ownership_boundary.F_PM: Consume only the qualified view. Irrigation must not read HeadCalc/reference-Richards internals directly.
ownership_boundary.F_KT: Retains ownership of committed/candidate/trial identity and transaction publication semantics.

non_goals: No irrigation equations or production irrigation source.
No prescribed bottom-head work and no modification of F-SI16 source files.
No change to soil-water solver physics or numerical policy.
qualification_requirements: missing or shape-invalid state fails closed
snapshot does not alias source arrays
existing common solver contract still compiles unchanged
